description: Validated spectral eigenvalue computation for annular membrane boundary value problems. Compute eigenvalues (zeros of secular equations), the spectral zeta function, and McMahon asymptotic convergence products.

problems.description: First 15 positive zeros of f(x) = J_0(3x)*Y_0(x) - Y_0(3x)*J_0(x), the m=0 radial eigenvalues of the Dirichlet Laplacian on the annulus with inner radius 1 and outer radius 3 (DLMF 10.21). J_nu and Y_nu denote Bessel functions of the first and second kind of order nu.
First 15 positive zeros of g(x) = J_1(3x)*Y_1(x) - Y_1(3x)*J_1(x), the m=1 radial eigenvalues of the Dirichlet Laplacian on the same annulus r in [1,3].

First 10 positive zeros of h(x) = x*[J_0(2x)*Y_1(x) - J_1(x)*Y_0(2x)] - 5*[J_0(x)*Y_0(2x) - J_0(2x)*Y_0(x)]. This is the m=0 secular equation for the Laplacian on the annulus r in [1,2] with Robin boundary condition (Biot number h=5, i.e. du/dn + 5u = 0) at the inner boundary r=1 and Dirichlet condition (u=0) at the outer boundary r=2. Derived by expanding u(r) = A*J_0(lambda*r) + B*Y_0(lambda*r) and eliminating coefficients via the boundary conditions.

spectral_zeta.description: Compute Z_4 = sum_{n=1}^{15} 1/lambda_{0,n}^4 + sum_{n=1}^{15} 2/lambda_{1,n}^4 + sum_{n=1}^{10} 1/mu_n^4 to 50 significant digits. Angular-mode multiplicities: m=0 Dirichlet modes have multiplicity 1, m=1 Dirichlet modes have multiplicity 2 (cos(theta) and sin(theta) angular parts), Robin-Dirichlet modes have multiplicity 1. Here lambda_{0,n} are the annular_m0 zeros, lambda_{1,n} are the annular_m1 zeros, and mu_n are the robin_dirichlet zeros.

asymptotic_validation.description: For each annular_m0 zero lambda_n (n=1..15), compute the McMahon asymptotic convergence product P_n = n^2 * |lambda_n - n*pi/2| / lambda_n. By the McMahon asymptotic expansion for Bessel cross-product zeros on the annulus [1,3] with nu=0, these products converge to 1/(6*pi^2) as n -> infinity. The convergence rate is O(1/n^2).

format.problems: Array of objects with keys: id (string matching problem id), zeros (array of objects with keys: index (int, 1-based), value (string, decimal representation with >= 60 significant digits), residual (string, |f(zero)| in scientific notation))
format.spectral_zeta_Z4: String with >= 50 significant digits representing the spectral zeta sum
format.asymptotic_products: Array of 15 objects with keys: n (int, 1 to 15), product (string, the P_n value), zero_value (string, the corresponding lambda_n)
